title: Honest Simultaneous Bands for Dose-Response Curves with Replicate Measurements and Unknown Error Laws
banked_reason: D-0.5 NO-PASS after the operator-authorized final v9: HuangZhang2023 supports observed-response moment regularity, not the proposed almost-sure uniform bound on every potential outcome.
gap_reasons: The cited CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 identification theorem assumes coordinate independence, not the proposal's uniform local characteristic-function lower modulus; the quantitative class restriction must be retagged novel with applicability justification or supported by another citation.

HuangZhang2023 supports consistency, unconfoundedness, positivity, and observed-response moment regularity, but not the proposal's almost-sure uniform bound on every potential outcome; the restriction needs a supporting source or transparent retagging and justification.
Angle 0 v9 exhausted the expressly authorized revision cap; the operator directed banking if any flag remained.
proof_attempt_summary: Nine proposal revisions repaired empirical-definition conventions, nuisance uncertainty, Sobolev representatives, pointwise causal identification, comparator coverage, and the finite-stratum hard family. The final review still assessed the kernel at field tier with no novelty or structure flags, but found that Huang--Zhang did not support the claimed uniform bound on all potential outcomes. The validity gate classified this as sound-but-unaccepted rather than refuted; nevertheless, the operator's final-repair cap required D-0.5 NO-PASS banking before D0.
tldr: Unknown-error repeated-measurement regression, replicate-based recovery of error laws, and deconvolution of regression numerators and denominators are established results and are not claimed as contributions. The first contribution is joint analytic identification, on a compact-support submodel, of the latent density and a distinct observed signed outcome channel when the two blind error laws may be nonidentical and asymmetric and their characteristic functions may vanish on open frequency sets. A local observable ratio and analytic continuation recover unique continuous Sobolev representatives; consistency, weak unconfoundedness, positivity, and potential-mean continuity then identify the causal ADRF pointwise on \(\mathcal I\). The second contribution is a uniformly honest simultaneous causal ADRF band from joint inversion of stratum masses and both transform channels, with width \(r_n=(\log\log n/\log n)^{\beta-1/2}\), a negligible root-\(n\) multinomial term, and explicit empty-stratum and zero-variance conventions. The third is a matching all-honest expected-width converse on a nonempty all-strata homogeneous Legendre--Bernoulli subclass that fixes the entire noisy-treatment marginal and leaves the marginal ADRF separation unattenuated. Continuity and \(\phi_r(0)=1\) guarantee a positive low-frequency modulus separately for each error law; the fixed common \(\nu\) and \(c_{\phi}\) used uniformly over the class are a maintained quantitative strength restriction, not a borrowed theorem or a novelty claim.
gap: LiVuong1998 identifies and estimates unknown latent and error densities from repeated indicators under global nonvanishing, Schennach2004 identifies and estimates a repeated-measurement nonparametric regression numerator and denominator under a global nonvanishing observed transform, and DelaigleHallMeister2008 proves first-order equivalence between unknown- and known-error density and regression point estimators under a common real-valued nowhere-zero error transform. Those foundational tasks are not novel here. The unresolved gap is simultaneous causal inference when the two blind errors are nonidentical and asymmetric and may have open spectral zero sets: no cited result jointly identifies the compact-support signed outcome channel in that regime, constructs a uniformly honest ADRF band, and proves a matching all-honest expected-width converse while holding the noisy-treatment marginal fixed.
fill: The project supplies exactly three root contributions: joint analytic identification of \(f_x\) and the signed \(q_x\) under blind nonidentical asymmetric open-zero errors, with pointwise ADRF recovery through the declared causal bridge; a total coupled inversion yielding a uniformly honest simultaneous causal band; and a matched all-honest expected-width converse from a quantitatively compatible all-strata homogeneous Bernoulli hard family. The confidence set jointly covers multinomial stratum masses and both empirical transform channels, while the fixed \(p^{\star}\), common \(f_0\), fixed errors, and identical smooth outcome perturbation keep the lower-bound noisy-treatment marginal fixed and the ADRF separation unattenuated.
